name: Mighty Archer
summary:
Step into the heat of battle in this fast-paced VR archery wave shooter. Armed with a bow, you'll face relentless waves of bizarre multi-eyed slimes  surging across a volcanic landscape dominated by a looming dark tower.
Track your score, manage your lives, and survive as long as you can. With intuitive bow mechanics built for VR, every shot counts. Aim true, stay cool under pressure, and become the last defender standing
